title: Chief Technology Officer
content: <p>ZZ-TEST-SCAN synthetic detail. Reports to the CEO. Base $300,000 - $350,000. This synthetic Chief Technology Officer posting exists purely to exercise the scan pipeline end to end: normalization, prescoring, dedup classification, and the detail-fetch phase, against a fixture board that answers exactly like a real Greenhouse job board would. The role oversees technology strategy, engineering leadership, and cross-functional delivery for a fictitious mid-market company headquartered in Houston, Texas, reporting directly to the chief executive officer.</p>
